observed_baselines.scope: descriptive sodium/force reproduction with discrepancies; conditional author posterior

radiation_signal_count_upper.scope: Poisson event-count upper without background subtraction

selected_envelope_feasibility.scope: stationary-body response approximation and deterministic published envelopes

white_joint_confidence_region.reason: No joint nuisance/coverage construction; isolated force load and convention reconciliation incomplete

colored_joint_physics.reason: Moving-apparatus response in a common noise frame and full detector windows are not established

arbitrary_spectrum_exclusion.reason: No empirically derived positive sodium kernel or all-frequency instrument certificate

radiation_parameter_exclusion.reason: Public subset lacks energy migration and full 2026 range/calibration likelihood

novel_physics_result.reason: Closely related theory is established; novelty not demonstrated
